requisito: Given a list of order quantities and a box capacity, computes the integer total of boxes needed when packing each order separately. Ignores non-positive quantities and returns 0 if capacity is not positive.

difetti.indizio: Look at the operator used to divide by capienza.
difetti.spiegazione: In Python 3 the / operator always performs floating-point division, returning a float with a fractional part (4.25) instead of integer floor division //.

difetti.indizio: Look at the numerator of the floor division.
difetti.spiegazione: Without subtracting 1 from the numerator (q + capienza - 1), whenever q is an exact multiple of capacity (e.g. 4), one extra box is counted.
